segments.source: formWindow(usingSequence:result:isHalfWindow:)
**Framework**: Accelerate **Kind**: method
Populates a double-precision vector with a specified window.
**Availability**:
iPadOS 13.0+
Mac Catalyst ?+
macOS 10.15+
tvOS 13.0+
visionOS ?+
watchOS 6.0+
Declaration

```swift
static func formWindow<V>(usingSequence sequence: vDSP.WindowSequence, result: inout V, isHalfWindow: Bool) where V : AccelerateMutableBuffer, V.Element == Double
```
segments.ko:
```swift
static func formWindow<V>(usingSequence sequence: vDSP.WindowSequence, result: inout V, isHalfWindow: Bool) where V : AccelerateMutableBuffer, V.Element == Double
```

segments.source: Discussion
Use this function to populate a vector with values of a specified window sequence.
segments.ko: 지정된 window 시퀀스의 값으로 벡터를 채우려면 이 함수를 사용합니다.

segments.source: The following code shows how to generate a single-precision Blackman window:
segments.ko: 다음 코드는 단정밀도 Blackman 윈도우를 생성하는 방법을 보여줍니다.

segments.source:
```swift
var c = [Double](repeating: 0,
                 count: 1024)

vDSP.formWindow(usingSequence: .blackman,
                result: &c,
                isHalfWindow: false)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
var c = [Double](repeating: 0,
                 count: 1024)

vDSP.formWindow(usingSequence: .blackman,
                result: &c,
                isHalfWindow: false)
```

segments.source: The following figure illustrates the values of the output vector, `c`:
![Visualization of a Blackman window.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/60bd6fe48f68c85247dc2dc8de350818/media-3362253%402x.png)
Parameters
`sequence`: The window sequence to use for generation.
`result`: The destination vector that receives the result.
`isHalfWindow`: A Boolean value that specifies whether the function generates half of the number of elements.
segments.ko: `isHalfWindow`: 함수가 생성할 요소 수의 절반을 지정하는 부울 값입니다.
